description_en: Queries the information about a specific file uploaded by a specified device to IoT Platform
description_zh: 查询指定设备上传到物联网平台的指定文件信息
name: QueryDeviceFile

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page is displayed or no </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备所隶属的产品ProductKey。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the device to query.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device to query. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.
If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device, and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The file identifier. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112001.html and view the file ID in the response
parameters.help_zh: 文件标识符。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112001.html，从返回结果中查看文件ID
parameters.name: file_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The file information returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的文件信息

DownloadUrl.description_en: The download URL of the file

UtcCreatedOn.description_en: The time when the file was created

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
